## Load Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
library("here") 
library("scales")
```

## Load data

```{r}
biopsy_data_file <- here("data", "biopsy.csv")
if(dir.exists("data")) {
    print("data directory already exists")
  } else {
    print("Creating data directory")
    dir.create(path = "data")
  }
  
if(file.exists(biopsy_data_file)) {
    print("biopsy.csv already exists, loading data")
  
    biopsy_data <- read_csv(file = biopsy_data_file, 
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    print("Retriving data")
    
    # Retrieve the data
    biopsy_data <- read_csv(file = "https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv",
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

    # Write the data to disk
    write_csv(x = biopsy_data, file = biopsy_data_file)
  }
```

## Analysis

### Applying PCA model

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy_data |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

### 2D data representation in PC coordinates

Extracting explained variance for PC1 and PC2:

```{r}
explained_var <- pca_fit |> 
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") |> 
  select(percent) |> 
  slice_head(n = 2) |> 
  pull()
```

Construting 2D scatter plot of data projected onto the two major principle components:

```{r}
pca_fit |>
  augment(biopsy_data) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1,
             y = .fittedPC2,
             color = outcome,
             shape = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       title = "Breast cancer biopsy data projected on PCs",
       subtitle = str_c(
    "Variance explained by PC1 and PC2 respectively is: ",
    percent(explained_var[1], accuracy = 0.1),
    " and ",
    percent(explained_var[2], accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    color = "Outcome",
    shape = "Outcome"
  )
```
